turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.
A colleague will take over and review the decision about the raised scratch on your print.

input.summary: Customer says they previously reported a scrape on the print and staff replied it was part of the artwork. They dispute that decision, describing it as a raised scratch across the ink. Please review the damage decision and contact them.
